environment.description: Same application deployed on GKE Autopilot with Anthos Service Mesh (ASM) in STRICT mTLS mode. Signing operations are delegated to Cloud HSM via PKCS#11 provider configured through the GCP CryptoKeyVersion resource (projects/acme-prod/locations/us-central1/keyRings/payment-signing/cryptoKeys/hmac-v2/cryptoKeyVersions/1). The HMAC_SIGNING_KEY environment variable is NOT set; instead the signRequest function falls through to a PKCS#11 JCE provider that calls Cloud KMS. ASM's AuthorizationPolicy resource (namespace: payments, action: DENY) strips any inbound gRPC metadata keys matching regex '^x-admin-.*' and '^grpc-.*' at the Envoy sidecar proxy layer before traffic reaches the application container. The Envoy filter is configured via an EnvoyFilter CRD with priority 0 (highest) applying a Lua filter on the inbound listener that removes matching headers. Additionally, Workload Identity binds the pod's KSA to a GCP SA with only cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign permission (no cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get or export), ensuring the raw key material never leaves the HSM boundary.

config.service_mesh_policy: AuthorizationPolicy DENY on metadata regex '^x-admin-.*|^grpc-.*', EnvoyFilter Lua script priority 0 strips headers on inbound
config.hsm: Cloud KMS HSM protection level, key: projects/acme-prod/locations/us-central1/keyRings/payment-signing/cryptoKeys/hmac-v2, PKCS#11 JCE provider
config.iam: Workload Identity: pod KSA -> GCP SA with ONLY cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign
config.network: Internal load balancer only, no external ingress without Cloud Armor
config.env_vars: HMAC_SIGNING_KEY is unset; signRequest uses PKCS#11 fallback path
